claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the lotion for healing dry, cracked, and rough skin, often calling it the best they've tried.
Many reviewers highlight that it is non-greasy, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave skin oily or slimy.
Several reviewers consider it a great value and inexpensive compared to other lotions.
A few reviewers complain about the packaging and dispensing, mentioning a hard-to-use cap or bottles arriving open and spilled.
A small number of reviewers report negative experiences, including that it didn't moisturize and had an uninviting smell.
